workflow.trigger: one path-filtered push workflow plus existing repository automatic workflows
workflow.source_fetch: Node fetch directly from frozen arxiv revision; reject wrong length or SHA256 before processing

phase_plan: Recheck exact source/gate/tool Git blob revisions and the open original L01-S004 disposition on branch checkout.
Run exact pinned-v0.2 Python selftest and 140625 synthetic independent-fraction oracle cases locally within one workflow job before original replay.
Fetch original PDF v1 from arxiv and require 623525 bytes and pinned SHA256.
Check PDF 31 pages, Figure 1 original caption, page-3 extracted text SHA256 and 96-DPI raster SHA256 (compare renderer-dependent hashes separately).
Run pdftocairo source SVG export and compare predecessor SVG hash as environment-specific diagnostic, not an intrinsic source identity.

Execute v0.2 transform-aware SVG candidate stroke extraction in a bounded PDF-points crop [270,275,540,495]; report candidate samples, raw/expanded counts and unresolved clip/CSS/use/curved-path obligations.
Preserve all pre-existing research failures/limitations and report source-graph/topology as UNQUALIFIED; acquire independent image-only graph endpoint decoding in a later phase.
falsifiers: Any original PDF byte/hash/page-count mismatch aborts immediately.
Any source SSC, L01 source-inverse, candidate model, stage-gate or selected tool blob mismatch aborts before source interpretation.
A failed synthetic region oracle cannot be masked by a successful source download.
Missing SVG or unexpected source page dimensions aborts this mechanical attempt.
SVG parse incomplete, transformed glyphs, clipped drawings, and visually ambiguous geometry must remain explicit open debts.
Identical SVG/raster hashes do not imply source semantic reconstruction; changed renderer hashes do not imply changed source binary.
Proposed physical field actions from the author's prose must not be imported as ink-stroke edge oracle.
Woit source semantics and project unification hypotheses remain unavailable to L G0 source interpretation.
